messages:
Lina M.: kicked off a cohort-aware batch-window sensitivity sweep across us-west (A100) and apac-south (H100). quick summary below, full logs in the run artifact.
Raj K.: awesome — high level TL;DR?
Lina M.: TL;DR: small window (20–40ms) favors p50 but loses throughput for long-context cohorts; 80ms hit a throughput sweet spot for mixed cohorts and reduced tail imbalance. apac H100 shows steeper throughput gains vs A100 for larger windows.
Diego R.: can you paste the numbers? even roughs
Lina M.: sure, here's the condensed table I copied from the aggregator (tokens/s and p99 in ms):
```
window(ms) | us-west A100 (mixed) tokens/s | p99(ms) | apac H100 (mixed) tokens/s | p99(ms)
20         |  880                           |  42     | 1100                       |  38
40         | 1100                           |  56     | 1450                       |  48
80         | 1350                           |  92     | 1850                       |  86
160        | 1250                           | 160     | 1700                       | 140
```
Lina M.: fairness/tail-ratio (90/50 latency) for cohort split (short/long): 20ms=1.34, 40ms=1.21, 80ms=1.09, 160ms=1.18. so 80ms minimized imbalance.
Tasha: interesting that p99 jumps a lot at 80->160 on both GPUs. any kernel differences? which kernels selected?
Lina M.: yes — on H100 the runtime picked the fused-attn-ffn kernel at 80ms; at 160ms it switched to matmul-streaming fallback for long sequences (worse tail). A100 stayed on matmul-tiling path earlier.
Evan: what about max-batch-tokens? did you cap or use unlimited?
Lina M.: capped at 2048 tokens/batch for these runs to keep memory stable; also ran a follow-up with 4096 cap — throughput improved ~8% on H100 at 80ms but p99 worsened for long-context cohort.
Marta: any quantization in these runs? q4_0/q4f?
Lina M.: these are q4_0 for both regions. we have a q4f run queued — expect slightly better tail but need to validate quality.
scheduler-bot: autoscale event: bumped apac-south pool by 2 nodes at 2087654380 (for the sweep). :robot_face:
Diego R.: did you try cohort pinning? e.g., keep long-context requests on a dedicated cohort to avoid head-of-line
Lina M.: yes — pinned long-context cohort to a dedicated slider group. results: long-context p99 improved 25%, overall throughput dropped 6% (because less coalescing across cohorts). tradeoff worth it for SLAs.
Raj K.: what's next? production rollout candidate?
Lina M.: next steps:
- run q4f sweep (H100/A100) with 80ms window and 4096 max-batch-tokens
- test cohort pinning with dynamic warmup (pre-warm KV cache per cohort)
- run kernel-forcing experiment to force fused-attn-ffn on A100 and matmul-tiling on H100 to isolate kernel effect
- add quality gating on q4f to catch regressions
I'll post the run links and a short notebook tomorrow.
Tasha: thanks — can you link the artifact when you post? want to check per-model-variant curves.
Lina M.: will do. tagging @Raj K. for scheduling the q4f runs (we'll need 6 H100 slots for ~3h).
